by.claim: policies/finance-and-billing.md and policies/client-accounts.md establish that TTS/18F is a fee-for-service, cost-recoverable organization funded through the Acquisition Services Fund, meaning expenses (predominantly salaries) must be recovered by billing specific client engagements — reinforced by policies/time-tracking-and-rates.md, which classifies 'business development for new projects' as explicitly nonbillable. rfc-003-cybersecurity-advisor.md proposes a Senior Cybersecurity Advisor role in the Front Office whose hours go to 'coordination across programs, advice to teams, hiring support, and training' — 'None of that is work assigned to a single engagement' — while conceding 'a funding source for this role should be identified' and that determining budget/staff is itself the role's first task. This is a commitment the RFC has not reconciled with the org's cost-recovery funding model, and the RFC assigns the resolution to the 18F Executive Director, who must identify the funding source before the role can be sustained.
